answer: The dune multiplier is published, charged in comet, and tide lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 14 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 1533 identities would post 1204 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
